## Same place (GPL-3.0-only section 6(d))

The complete Corresponding Source for this release is available on the same
release page as the binaries: https://github.com/alexmarincu/stemforge/releases/tag/v1.0.0.

| Asset | URL |
|---|---|
| `StemForge-1.0.0-src.tar.gz` | https://github.com/alexmarincu/stemforge/releases/download/v1.0.0/StemForge-1.0.0-src.tar.gz |
| `StemForge-1.0.0-third-party-sources.tar.zst` | https://github.com/alexmarincu/stemforge/releases/download/v1.0.0/StemForge-1.0.0-third-party-sources.tar.zst |

The first asset is the exact tagged source tree, including `packaging/`,
the PyInstaller specs, the licence generator, and the build scripts. The
second contains the third-party sources listed below. The committed
human-readable vendor record is `packaging/vendor/SOURCES.md`.

## Written offer (GPL-3.0-only section 6(b))

StemForge offers, under GPL-3.0-only section 6(b), the complete
Corresponding Source for every GPL-licensed binary it ships.

This written offer is valid for **three years** from the release date
(2026-2029). Send requests to
https://github.com/alexmarincu/stemforge/issues.

A machine-readable copy is provided for no more than the cost of
physically performing source distribution.

## FFmpeg build configuration

The shipped `ffmpeg -buildconf` output is captured by the release build
into `LICENSES/ffmpeg/BUILDINFO.txt`; the committed
`packaging/vendor.lock.json` records the BtbN tag, version commit, and
archive SHA-256 that reproduce it.

## Not included

StemForge ships **no model weights**. The `htdemucs` weights are downloaded
from Hugging Face at the user's explicit request under pinned revision and
SHA-256 and are not covered by StemForge's GPL-3.0 licence (ADR 0009). No
source obligation attaches to them, and no weights are in this tree.
